high_level_description: This image is a four-panel comic strip featuring dinosaurs. The setting appears to be a pond or water body surrounded by trees and a wooden fence. Panel 1: A small green dinosaur is standing on the shore of the pond, looking at another larger dinosaur that is partially submerged in the water. The small dinosaur asks, "I want to be an astronaut, can I?" The larger dinosaur responds with, "Sure! come in." Panel 2: The small dinosaur thanks the larger dinosaur and enters the water. The larger dinosaur, labeled as "Astronomy," is still partially submerged.
